requirements.definition: I shall be of type integer.

S16.9.121-001 intrinsics_16_9_p runtime fixture: LEADZ is called with an integer actual argument; the zero-bit result is checked against BIT_SIZE of that argument.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. LEADZ p3 admits integer actual arguments, not BOZ actual arguments; BOZ literal coverage is therefore not registered for this intrinsic. requirements.title: LEADZ counts leading zero bits in the 16.3 integer bit model
requirements.definition: For all-zero bits LEADZ returns BIT_SIZE(I); otherwise it returns BIT_SIZE(I)-1-k, where k is the position of the leftmost 1 bit in I using the 16.3 bit model.
